g.title: op:addmodulescore Seurat-style module scoring using matched control features by expression bin.
op:cell_set_derive Materialize a selector-derived or explicitly declared cell universe as a named cell set with lifecycle role/status and manifest tables.
op:cell_suffix_label Build a categorical cell vector by parsing cell_id suffix tokens.
op:cell_vector_assoc Test whether a continuous cell-level signal differs across groups defined by a categorical cell-level vector.
op:cell_vector_compare Compare two cell-level signals on their shared cell universe in raw or rank space.
op:cell_vector_family_calibrate Normalize one keyed per-cell signal family within keys so cross-key comparisons become more meaningful.
op:cell_vector_family_graph_smooth Smooth each key of a cell_vector_family over local nearest-neighbor geometry in a selected bundle space.
op:cell_vector_family_qc Compute per-key and pairwise diagnostics for one keyed per-cell signal family.
op:cell_vector_family_reduce Compress a cell_vector_family into one categorical cell_vector using explicit reduction and abstention rules.
op:cell_vector_winners Assign one winning key per cell from a cell_vector_family and report confidence and pruning metrics.
op:chromvar Bias-corrected chromVAR deviations on a peak matrix using genome-backed GC bias and motif matching against a JASPAR PWM catalog.
op:de_wilcox Wilcoxon rank-sum DE between two cell groups (A vs B).
op:feature_set_import Import GMT/RDS/table feature-set libraries into the bundle feature-set registry and emit import provenance tables.
op:feature_set_namespace_transfer Transfer matrix-scoped feature-set namespaces between comparable matrices using mirror or intersect semantics.
op:feature_set_overlap_qc Screen imported feature-set namespaces against a matrix before pathway or trajectory discovery.
op:feature_trend_spearman Feature-level Spearman trend testing against continuous pseudotime-like vectors.
op:knn_neighbors Find nearest neighbors in a latent space without requiring matrix aggregation.
op:knn_pseudobulk Find k nearest neighbors in latent space around query cells and aggregate matrix values.
op:leiden Graph clustering on a kNN graph derived from an embedding space.
op:markers_topn One-vs-rest Wilcoxon marker ranking for each cluster.
op:matrix_log_normalize Create a reusable log1p(counts / library_size * scale_factor) BPCells matrix in the bundle.
op:monocle3_fit Fit monocle3 graph/pseudotime using a scworkbench latent space injected into monocle3's UMAP slot.
op:monocle3_project Project a fitted monocle3 trajectory graph into a 2D display space.
op:palantir_fit Run Palantir pseudotime/branch probabilities on a scworkbench latent space via the pybench Python runtime.
op:palantir_project Project Palantir branch trajectories into a 2D display space using Palantir-style mellon interpolation from the fitted Palantir model.
op:pathway_enrich Hypergeometric enrichment against all feature sets in a namespace.
op:peakvi_fit Train a PeakVI model on a matrix via the pybench Python runtime and emit a latent space plus model reference.
op:peakvi_project Project cells from an ATAC matrix through a saved PeakVI model and emit a latent space.
op:slingshot Infer lineage curves and pseudotime from clusters in a 2D space.
op:slingshot_fit Fit Slingshot lineages/pseudotime in a chosen fit space (typically latent/PCA).
op:slingshot_lineage_weights Extract Slingshot lineage membership weights from an existing model_ref without refitting, preserving trajectory_fit_id and lineage mapping.
op:slingshot_project Project a fitted Slingshot model into a 2D display space (e.g. UMAP).
op:space_path_define Contract scaffold for checkpoint-anchored path construction in a named analytical space.
op:space_path_project_2d Contract scaffold for projecting an analytical path into a drawable 2D path family.
op:space_path_score Contract scaffold for path-relative scoring in a named analytical space.
op:trajectory_branch_compare Compare two trajectory branches feature-by-feature using explicit pseudotime and branch membership primitives.
op:trajectory_de Lineage-aware feature trend testing against trajectory pseudotime from model_ref.
op:trajectory_geneset_dynamics Screen all feature sets in a namespace for dynamic behavior along trajectory pseudotime.
op:trajectory_route_smooth Summarize per-feature expression along an explicit route using global pseudotime plus route membership weights.
op:trajectory_segment_from_artifacts Materialize the generic trajectory segment contract from fitted-model trajectory artifacts with fit-family validation.
op:trajectory_segment_join Join ordered generic trajectory segments into an auditable composite pseudotime without merging parent trajectory models.
op:trajectory_segment_path_join Join ordered parent path_2d_family segments into a derived composite display curve without merging parent trajectory models.
op:trajectory_signal_dynamics Rank precomputed cell-level signal families by dynamic behavior along trajectory pseudotime.
op:trajectory_signature_smooth Summarize feature-set signature scores along trajectory pseudotime into reusable trend tables.
op:trajectory_smooth Summarize per-feature expression along trajectory pseudotime into reusable trend tables.
op:trajectory_space_path_segment Convert space_path_score output into a generic trajectory segment using path-progress pseudotime and transparent distance-based membership.
op:trajectory_vector_smooth Summarize cell-level signal families along trajectory pseudotime into reusable trend tables.
op:ucell Rank-based per-cell signature scoring using the UCell method.
op:umap_fit Fit a UMAP model on a space and store it for future projection.
op:umap_transform Project cells into an existing UMAP using a stored model.
op:winner_cell_sets Register bundle cell sets from a cell_vector_winners obs_table and return a manifest table.
primitive:cell_vector One value per cell, continuous or categorical.
primitive:cell_vector_family Long-form collection of keyed per-cell vectors.
primitive:feature_table Data frame where rows are feature-centric results such as genes, peaks, or markers.
primitive:matrix Symbolic reference to a feature-by-cell matrix stored in the bundle.
primitive:model_ref Reference to a stored model artifact and the spaces it maps between.
primitive:obs_table Generic observation-style data frame specialized by table_type and entity_kind.
primitive:path_2d_family Lineage or curve coordinates in a 2D plotting space.
primitive:relation_family Sparse long-form cell-to-key relations with optional weights, values, or distances.
primitive:space Symbolic reference to a cell embedding or latent space stored in the bundle.
primitive:space_2d Reference to a two-dimensional cell space, typically UMAP-like coordinates.
primitive:space_path_family Curves in an arbitrary-dimensional bundle space, represented point-by-dimension.
